title: Red blood cell folate concentrations increase more after supplementation with [6S]-5-methyltetrahydrofolate than with folic acid in women of childbearing age
authors: Lamers Y, Prinz-Langenohl R, Brämswig S, Pietrzik K
population: Healthy women aged 19 to 33 years in Germany
inKindSupport: The synthetic form of [6S]-5-methyltetrahydrofolate, Metafolin, was provided by Merck Eprova AG (Schaffhausen, Switzerland).
result: Results read from the published abstract. Folic acid 400 µg, an equimolar 416 µg [6S]-5-methyl-THF, 208 µg [6S]-5-methyl-THF or placebo daily. Red cell folate rose more with 416 µg 5-methyl-THF than with 400 µg folic acid or 208 µg 5-methyl-THF (P < 0.001); red cell folate had not plateaued in any group by 24 weeks, whereas plasma folate plateaued after 12 weeks. Neural tube defects were not an outcome.
